notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Wow, this year has been both incredible and incredibly challenging. A lot has happened, but even in the most difficult moments, your support has been invaluable. Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts!

We can't wait to show you what's in store for you next year, but you'll have to wait a little longer. For now, Happy 2025 to you all!

See you soon,

-WaifuProd Team

notes.title: Love and Demons - Little Updates | Upcoming Stuff and More!
notes.notes:
Welcome back! It's been a while, hasn't it? 

We've been working hard behind the scenes to focus on the game, but now we're back! This small update is here to catch you up on our latest progress and upcoming [b]Dev. Blogs![/b]

First, we've updated our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2755170/view/4165346503368430262?l=english]1st Dev. Blog[/url] with new character graphics! 
[i](Max even went to the barbershop, can you imagine that?)[/i]

We've also uploaded brand-new screenshots and more on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2755170/Love_and_Demons/]Steam Page[/url], be sure to check them out!

And that’s not all, a series of Dev. Blogs focused on [b]Key Game Mechanics[/b] in [b]Love and Demons[/b] will be released soon. 

We’ll dive into topics like [b]Statistics,[/b] [b]Dice Rolls,[/b] [b]Secrets,[/b] consequences of your [b]Choices[/b] in the game, and [b]much more![/b]

Thank you for following along, and we’ll be back soon with more updates... don't worry, it won't be long!

See you soon,

-WaifuProd Team

notes.title: Love and Demons - Dev. Blog #1 | Main Characters Showcase
notes.notes:
[p]Hello There! A warm greeting from Waifu Production!

With the upcoming release of our first work ever, Love and Demons, we’d like to give you a [b]bigger insight[/b] of our [b]main characters[/b]. You sure already had the pleasure to meet our hero and heroines through our Steam page and Twitter posts. However, today we’re taking a [b]closer look than ever before[/b] at our main cast, being sure not to reveal too much. None of us wants spoilers.  [/p][p]No more chatter, let us introduce our stars, starting from our front girl! [/p][p][/p][h2]Karen[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947179/a37586eb1807d012026fd0f0d897c670c83121bb.png"][/img][/p][p]The first of the three girls we’ll talk about is a living paradox, at least according to common belief. Succubi are typically imagined to have specific characteristics, but let’s not get into those details. On the contrary, in Love and Demons our Succubus is super shy! Ever since Karen began to develop her powers, she has never been able to control them properly, which is why she has always found herself in unpleasant situations, attracting unwanted attention.

Attracting others is an innate ability of hers, but one that she has never appreciated, which is why she has completely changed social sides, spending most of her time with plants, becoming an expert botanist and finding herself at ease even with the most dangerous kinds in the Demon Realm. The difficulty in talking to her lies precisely in not being enchanted or killed by the countless dangerous plants that accompany Karen in her daily life. She is therefore a very unusual and unconventional character, but above all, she is stubborn and resolute, so don’t think about putting obstacles in her way or you’ll get to witness some interesting things!

[/p][h2]Lilith[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947179/5949c87b054878a12232654c95e85fe31637cde0.png"][/img][/p][p]Directly from the highest ranks of the royal family, we have Lilith, an Archdevil, as well as the strongest demonic race in circulation. Just like our protagonist, she is the heir to the throne, but as you can well imagine, of a rather different kingdom. She is characterized by her great will to help others at all costs, which has led her to accomplish great deeds that are still recognized to this day.

Unfortunately, like everyone, she has her flaws and her main problem is her feelings. She finds it difficult to express her true feelings, but this struggle gives her a unique trait. Despite her training to maintain full control over her powers, losing her composure directly affects her ability to restrain them. Fortunately, ever since she was little, she has always devoted to training to avoid losing her temper. However, this doesn’t guarantee that she won’t lose it again today. Should it ever happen, good luck, soldier, I hope you are trained to survive some quite powerful explosions!

[/p][h2]Aurelia[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947179/7b9a814e024d3f77e0e48d4b01b8e0ba42af0355.png"][/img][/p][p]A demon with a mysterious aura, cunning and manipulative, very similar to Lilith. It is difficult to explain what goes through her mind and what Aurelia is truly like, but rest assured that once you have gotten to know her, you will not want to be targeted by her for anything in the world. 

However, as we know, every troubled character hides a difficult past, which you will have to discover with the sweat of your brow, understanding why this girl always strives to be one step ahead of everyone and seems to be mocking anyone. Keep in mind that she is not of noble blood unlike her rival, but is the daughter of the castle servants, an environment that has forged her tough character which may conceal something deeper. She hates being mistaken for Lilith and among all the girls, she is the most difficult to deal with in every regard. We challenge anyone to be able to fully discover her without trouble. It’s almost impossible!

[/p][h2]Maximilian[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947179/a0f62a8e87f7ef78c90e090b997109d7f9b60c1b.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve all had that one friend at school that was smart but didn’t apply himself. Max is one of those. Shrewd like few and sly as a fox, our hero definitely won’t represent any noble ideals since he’s in a constant escape from his crown prince typical responsibilities. His heart of gold will find his way in your souls though! As you surely understand, he’s not quite the knight, we could say he’s an anti-knight. He has in fact the kindness of a man-at-arms, but his moral code points towards results more than ways. His objective now is one, and maybe this is the only time he craves it: to come back home, possibly alive.

Having literally stumbled into the Demon Realm, the only solution to find his way back is to consult with the foremost figure of this world, the Demon King, whose powers and identity are completely unknown to him.

And we are done with the main cast, what do you think? Feel free to give us your feedback, it is precious to us. Of course, the characters don't stop here, the Demon Realm is full of demons with the most absurd powers and personalities, which you may discover if you continue to follow us. We can’t wait to introduce them to you, but please be patient, we are going to reveal them and a lot of more about Love and Demons before the release. 

Having said that, we bid you farewell, thanks a lot for reading this first Developers Blog and thank you for the constant support!

See you soon,

-WaifuProd Team[/p]
